goal: Prevent the Lark polling fallback from replaying already-handled messages after an adapter restart.

acceptance_criteria.description: Seen Lark message ids are persisted to the AstrBot temp directory so polling and socket dedupe survives process restarts.
When no persisted seen-message cache exists, polling starts at current time instead of replaying the full startup backfill window.
When a persisted seen-message cache exists, polling keeps the configured backfill window while skipping already seen message ids.
